entries.label: heading
entries.text: CONVENING OF SPECIAL SITTING OF THE SENATE TO DISCUSS THE REVENUE SHARING FORMULA AND OTHER BUSINESS

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Hon. Senators, on the request of the Senate Majority Leader via letter Reference No. SEN/SML/COR dated 20th July, 2020, and with the support of the requisite number of Senators, I appointed today, Thursday, 23rd July, 2020, as a day for a Special Sitting of the Senate vide Gazette Notice No.4956 dated 22nd July, 2020. In the Gazette Notice, I indicated that the business to be transacted at this Special Sitting shall be the consideration of- (i) The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) (No.3) Bill (National Assembly Bills No.35 of 2019); (ii) The County Tourism Bill (Senate Bills No.5 of 2019); (iii) The Care and Protection of Child Parents Bill (Senate Bills No.11 of 2019); and, (iv) The Third Basis for allocating, among the counties, the share of national revenue that is annually allocated to the counties. These agenda items are reflected in the Order Papers for the morning and afternoon sittings. Hon. Senators, concerning debate on the Third Basis for allocating, revenue among the county governments, the share of national revenue, the Chairperson of the Standing Committee on Finance and Budget laid on the Table of the Senate the report of the Standing Committee and gave Notice of Motion for its consideration during the Special Sitting of the Senate held on Monday, 13th July, 2020. What is left for the Senate to do is debate the Motion and make a determination on the matter. I have received notification from several Senators that they intend to move amendments to the Motion. These amendments have been reviewed by the Parliament Budget Office (PBO) and the Office of the Clerk of the Senate and are appended to the Order Papers. As I indicated in my Communication during the Special Sitting held on 13th July, 2020, debate on the Motion at Order Nos.2 and 1 in the Order Papers shall be considered and disposed of in accordance with Part 12 on Motions and Part 17 on Rules of Debate of the Standing Orders. Hon. Senators, in accordance with Standing Order No.35, the business specified in the Gazette Notice and as outlined above shall be the only business before the Senate during the Special Sitting, following which the Senate shall stand adjourned until Tuesday, 28th July, 2020, at 2.30 p.m. in accordance with the Senate Calendar. I thank you.

entries.speaker: Rose Nyamunga Ogendo
entries.text: Hon. Senators, we are now ready to give reports. I advise the Movers to be around, so that they can report. We will start with The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) Bill (National Assembly Bills No.35 of 2019).

entries.text: Madam Temporary Chairperson, I beg to move that the Committee do report to the Senate its consideration of The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) Bill (National Assembly Bills No. 35 of 2019) and its approval thereof with amendments.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Hon. Senators, please, remain in the Chamber because we will vote on the Third Readings of these Bills. Yes, Sen. Nyamunga.

entries.label: heading
entries.text: THE INDEPENDENT ELECTORAL AND BOUNDARIES COMMISSION (AMENDMENT) (NO.3) BILL (NATIONAL ASSEMBLY BILLS NO.35 OF 2019)

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Rose Nyamunga Ogendo
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I beg to report that the Committee of the Whole has considered The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) (No.3) Bill (National Assembly Bills No.35 of 2019) and its approval thereof with amendments.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Samuel Poghisio
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I beg to move that the House do agree with the Committee in the said Report. I ask Sen. Dullo to second.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Samuel Poghisio
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I beg to move that The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) (No. 3) Bill (National Assembly Bills No. 35 of 2019) be now read a Third Time. I ask Sen. Dullo to second.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Hon. Senators, we will do the three Divisions at the end. Yes, Chairperson.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Rose Nyamunga Ogendo
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I beg to report that the Committee of the Whole has considered The County Tourism Bill (Senate Bills No. 5 of 2019) and its approval thereof with amendments.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Sen. (Dr.) Ali
entries.text: Thank you, Mr. Speaker, Sir. I beg to move that the House do agree with the Committee on the said report. I ask Sen. (Dr.) Musuruve to support.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Sen. (Dr.) Ali
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I beg to move that The County Tourism Bill (Senate Bills No.5 of 2019) be now read a Third Time. I ask Sen. (Dr.) Musuruve to second.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: The Division will come at the end.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Beatrice Kwamboka Makori

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: I now direct that the Bell be rung for five minutes in respect of The Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) (No. 3) Bill.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: We are taking a Division on the Independent Electoral and Boundaries Commission (Amendment) (No. 3) (National Assembly Bills No. 35 of 2019). Those who are able to vote electronically will vote electronically and the others will be treated as assisted voters. Let us vote.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Assisted voters, are you through? Sen. (Prof.) Ongeri is the last one. Hon. Senators, as they tabulate the results, we can vote on The County Tourism Bill (Senate Bills No.5 of 2019). Let us vote.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Order Members. Let us take our seats. I realize you are not even observing social distance. Order Members! It is important you listen to what I am saying.

entries.label: heading
entries.text: ADOPTION OF REPORT ON THE THIRD BASIS FOR REVENUE ALLOCATION AMONG THE COUNTY GOVERNMENTS

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Samuel Poghisio
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I did ask for as a Special Sitting for 10.00 a.m. this morning. My request now is, because the Mover is not here, we consider adjourning---

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Samuel Poghisio
entries.text: Mr. Speaker, Sir, I request as the Senate Majority Leader that the meeting be held on another day so that we can make conclusions.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text: Order! Order Senators! There is only one Speaker in this Senate. The Senate Majority Leader had requested that we have this Special Sitting today. This is a matter of great concern. Therefore, I want to ask the Chairperson of the Committee to hasten this process because it is taking exceedingly long. He must provide leadership.

entries.label: speech
entries.speaker: Hon. Lusaka
entries.text:
Therefore, I am directing that the House be now adjourned to Tuesday, 28th July, 2020, at 2.30 p.m.

The Senate rose at 12.32 p.m.
